name: Direct checkout by URL
description: Provides a URL that builds a Commerce cart from SKUs in the query string and redirects the visitor straight to checkout.
project_description: Makes it possible to share a link that builds a Commerce cart from products passed in the query string and redirects the visitor directly to the checkout page. Products are addressed by SKU. Two request shapes are accepted: a comma-separated list of SKUs (each added with quantity 1) via '?products=1234,5678', or an array carrying explicit quantities via '?products[0][sku]=1234&products[0][quantity]=2'. Each SKU is loaded as a Commerce product variation, checked against the availability manager, and added to the visitor's default cart at its server-resolved price; the cart is then either kept or emptied first depending on the 'reset_cart' setting. After adding, the controller redirects to the checkout form for the cart order (or to the cart page if nothing was added). Because the redirect is a normal internal redirect, Drupal's built-in 'destination' query parameter can send the visitor somewhere else instead (for example '&destination=cart').
